# Load the raw data file and create a phyloseq object 

# uploaded file with ASVs 

asv_raw <- read.csv("Trimester2CS/Mergedfiles_EmilyEditFullASVs.csv", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

taxonomy_strings <- asv_raw[[1]]

asv_ids <- paste0("ASV", seq_len(nrow(asv_raw)))

rownames(asv_raw) <- asv_ids

count_data <- asv_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE]

count_data[] <- lapply(count_data, as.numeric)

otu_mat <- as.matrix(count_data)

tax_split <- strsplit(taxonomy_strings, ";")

tax_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tax_split, function(x) {
  length(x) <- 7
  return(x)
}))

colnames(tax_mat) <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
rownames(tax_mat) <- asv_ids

OTU <- otu_table(otu_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_mat))
ps <- phyloseq(OTU, TAX)
# combine with metadata 

metadata <- read.csv("Trimester2CS/T2CrossSectionMetadata_UpdatedSamples.csv")
setwd("../../../")
cst_data <- read.csv("CSTData.csv") # retrieve CST file generated from VALENCIA output 
names(cst_data)[names(cst_data) == "NEWsampleID"] <- "Sample_ID"
names(metadata)[names(metadata) == "Barcode_Sample.Name"] <- "Sample_ID"
metadata <- merge(metadata, cst_data[, c("Sample_ID", "CST")], by = "Sample_ID", all.x = TRUE)

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Sample_ID
metadata <- metadata[, !names(metadata) %in% "Sample_ID"]
sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(metadata)
# Run this to make sure no samples are dropped 

otu_samples <- sample_names(ps) 
meta_samples <- sample_names(metadata)
  
intersect(otu_samples, meta_samples)

# Filtering and data cleaning  

# Remove singletons
ps.prune = prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps) > 1, ps)


# Remove taxa that occur in less than 5% of samples 

ps.prune <- filter_taxa(ps.prune, function(x) sum(x > 0) > 0.05 * nsamples(ps), TRUE)

# Check read count
readcount_sr = data.table(as(sample_data(ps.prune), "data.frame"),
                 TotalReads = sample_sums(ps.prune), 
                 keep.rownames = TRUE)
setnames(readcount_sr, "rn", "SampleID")
# Check read count and determine which PIDs to remove from the data set

metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV <- paste(metadata.filtered$Ethnicity, metadata.filtered$HIV_Status, sep=" ")

sample_data(ps.filtered) <- metadata.filtered
# Demographic data table 

# Full data table for PWLWH and PWWH - first create demographic dataframe 

demographic.dataframe <- metadata.filtered %>% 
  select(PID, ARV.backbone, Base.drug, ART.Group, Age, Ethnicity,HIV_Status, Gestational.age1.wks, Gravida.number, Previous.livebirths.number, Term.birth, GA.at.delivery.weeks, Complication, Date.ART.commenced, CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL, HIV.viral.load.at.screening.copies.mL, Ethnicity_HIV,Body.Mass.Index.of.mother, Current.Alcohol.use, History.of.Alcohol.Excess, Current.tobacco.use, Complication)

demographic.dataframe$GA.at.delivery.weeks <- as.numeric(demographic.dataframe$GA.at.delivery.weeks)

demographic.dataframe <- demographic.dataframe %>%

      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )


demographic_summary <- demographic.dataframe %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_age = mean(Age, na.rm = FALSE),
    GAatVisit = mean(Gestational.age1.wks, na.rm = FALSE), 
    GADelivery = mean(GA.at.delivery.weeks, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_pregnancy = sum(Gravida.number == 1, na.rm = FALSE),
    oneplus_pregnancies = sum(Gravida.number > 1, na.rm = FALSE),
    PTB = sum(Term.birth == "N", na.rm = FALSE)
  )


print(demographic_summary)

# Creating table with statistical comparisons 

# load additional packages 

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
## 
## Attaching package: 'purrr'
## The following object is masked from 'package:data.table':
## 
##     transpose
library(broom)
## Warning: package 'broom' was built under R version 4.5.2
# Variables to skip in statistical tests 
skip_vars <- c("Current.Alcohol.use", "History.of.Alcohol.Excess", "Current.tobacco.use", "Term.birth")

all_vars <- c("Age", "Body.Mass.Index.of.mother", "Gestational.age1.wks", "GA.at.delivery.weeks",
              "Gravida.number", "Complication") 

# table w p values  

p_values <- map_dfr(
  all_vars,
  function(var) {
    x_raw <- demographic.dataframe[[var]]
    g <- demographic.dataframe$Ethnicity_HIV

    p <- NA
    test <- NA

    x_chr <- as.character(x_raw)
    x_chr_trim <- trimws(tolower(x_chr))
    missing_flag <- is.na(x_raw) | x_chr_trim %in% c("", "no record", "norecord", "no_record")
    missing_n <- sum(missing_flag, na.rm = TRUE)

    x_clean <- x_raw
    x_clean[missing_flag] <- NA

    if (var %in% c("Age", "Body.Mass.Index.of.mother", "Gestational.age1.wks", "GA.at.delivery.weeks")) {
      x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x_clean)))
      group_counts <- tapply(!is.na(x_num), g, sum)
      if (all(!is.na(group_counts)) && all(group_counts > 0)) {
        p <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(x_num ~ g)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
        test <- "Kruskal–Wallis"
      }
    } else {
    
      if (var == "Gravida.number") {

        tmp_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x_clean)))
        x_cat <- ifelse(!is.na(tmp_num) & tmp_num == 1, "First",
                        ifelse(!is.na(tmp_num) & tmp_num > 1, "OnePlus", NA))
      } else {
        x_cat <- as.character(x_clean)
      }

      
      tbl <- table(g, x_cat, useNA = "ifany")
      group_sums <- rowSums(tbl, na.rm = FALSE)

     
      non_missing_per_group <- tapply(!is.na(x_cat), g, sum)
      if (all(!is.na(non_missing_per_group)) && all(non_missing_per_group > 0)) {
        expected <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tbl)$expected)
        if (any(expected < 5, na.rm = TRUE)) {
          p <- tryCatch(fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
          test <- "Fisher’s Exact (MC)"
        } else {
          p <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tbl)$p.value)
          test <- "Chi-square"
        }
      }
    }

    tibble(
      Variable = var,
      p_value = round(p, 4),
      Test = test,
      Missing = missing_n
    )
  }
)

# Create summary table with counts and percentages/averages by group 

summary_tbl <- demographic.dataframe %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_age = paste0(
      sprintf("%.2f", median(Age, na.rm = TRUE)), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", quantile(Age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)), "–",
      sprintf("%.2f", quantile(Age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)), ")"
    ),
    BMI = paste0(
      sprintf("%.2f", median(Body.Mass.Index.of.mother, na.rm = TRUE)), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", quantile(Body.Mass.Index.of.mother, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)), "–",
      sprintf("%.2f", quantile(Body.Mass.Index.of.mother, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)), ")"
    ),
    GAatVisit = paste0(
      sprintf("%.2f", median(Gestational.age1.wks, na.rm = TRUE)), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", quantile(Gestational.age1.wks, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)), "–",
      sprintf("%.2f", quantile(Gestational.age1.wks, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)), ")"
    ),
    GADelivery = paste0(
      sprintf("%.2f", median(GA.at.delivery.weeks, na.rm = TRUE)), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", quantile(GA.at.delivery.weeks, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)), "–",
      sprintf("%.2f", quantile(GA.at.delivery.weeks, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)), ")"
    ),
    Alcohol_yes = paste0(
      sum(Current.Alcohol.use == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(Current.Alcohol.use == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    Tobacco = paste0(
      sum(Current.tobacco.use == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(Current.tobacco.use == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    first_pregnancy = paste0(
      sum(Gravida.number == 1, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(Gravida.number == 1, na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    oneplus_pregnancies = paste0(
      sum(Gravida.number > 1, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(Gravida.number > 1, na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    PTB = paste0(
      sum(Term.birth == "N", na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(Term.birth == "N", na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    Complication_yes = paste0(
      sum(Complication == "Y", na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(Complication == "Y", na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Ethnicity_HIV = paste0(Ethnicity_HIV, " (n=", n, ")")) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Ethnicity_HIV, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Ethnicity_HIV, values_from = Value)

# Map names so we know which raw variable each summary corresponds to
var_map <- c(
  mean_age = "Age",
  BMI = "Body.Mass.Index.of.mother",
  GAatVisit = "Gestational.age1.wks",
  GADelivery = "GA.at.delivery.weeks",
  Alcohol_yes = "Current.Alcohol.use",
  Alcohol_Excess = "History.of.Alcohol.Excess",
  Tobacco = "Current.tobacco.use",
  first_pregnancy = "Gravida.number",
  oneplus_pregnancies = "Gravida.number",
  PTB = "Term.birth",
  Complication_yes = "Complication"
)


# Combine summary table with p values 

final_table_with_p <- summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(TestVar = var_map[Variable]) %>%
  left_join(p_values, by = c("TestVar" = "Variable")) %>%
  select(-TestVar) %>%
  mutate(
    Missing = case_when(
      Variable == "PTB" ~ 3L,          
      Variable == "Alcohol_yes" ~ 0L,  
      Variable == "Tobacco" ~ 0L,      
      TRUE ~ Missing                   
    )
  )



final_table_with_p <- final_table_with_p %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ sprintf("%.2e", p_value),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", p_value)
    )
  )

final_table_with_p

# Test for significant Kruskal Wallis columns and add significant results to table manually as footnote 

# Load packages 

library(FSA)   
## Warning: package 'FSA' was built under R version 4.5.1
## Registered S3 methods overwritten by 'FSA':
##   method       from

library(dplyr)

kruskal_sig_vars <- p_values %>%
  filter(Test == "Kruskal–Wallis" & !is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Variable)

dunn_results <- map(kruskal_sig_vars, function(var) {
  dunn_test <- dunnTest(as.formula(paste(var, "~ Ethnicity_HIV")),
                        data = demographic.dataframe,
                        method = "bh")
  dunn_test$res %>%
    mutate(Variable = var)
})

dunn_results_tbl <- dunn_results_tbl %>% filter(P.adj < 0.05)

# Create dataframe for HIV only 

demographic.dataframe_HIV <- metadata.filtered %>%
  select(PID, ARV.backbone, Base.drug, ART.Group, Age, Ethnicity, HIV_Status,
         Gestational.age1.wks, Gravida.number, Previous.livebirths.number,
         Term.birth, GA.at.delivery.weeks, Complication, Date.ART.commenced,
         CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL, ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical, Visit.Date) %>%
  filter(HIV_Status == "HIV+") %>%
  mutate(
    GA.at.delivery.weeks = as.numeric(GA.at.delivery.weeks),
    ARTStartDate = if_else(Date.ART.commenced == "precon", as.Date(NA), dmy(Date.ART.commenced)),
    ART_precon_flag = Date.ART.commenced == "precon",
    VisitDate = dmy(Visit.Date),
    weeks_on_ART_precon = as.numeric(VisitDate - ARTStartDate) / 7,
    ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical = as.numeric(ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical),
    VL_over_200_flag = ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical > 50, # detectable HIV > 50 copies
    Precon_flag = Date.ART.commenced == "precon"
  )

ethnicity_labels <- demographic.dataframe_HIV %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity) %>%
  summarise(n_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Ethnicity_label = paste0(Ethnicity, " (n=", n_count, ")")) %>%
  select(-n_count)

demographic.dataframe_HIV <- demographic.dataframe_HIV %>%
  left_join(ethnicity_labels, by = "Ethnicity") %>%
  mutate(Ethnicity = Ethnicity_label) %>%
  select(-Ethnicity_label)

median_iqr <- function(x) {
  med <- sprintf("%.2f", median(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  q1  <- sprintf("%.2f", quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE))
  q3  <- sprintf("%.2f", quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
  paste0(med, " (", q1, "–", q3, ")")
}

baseline_stats <- demographic.dataframe_HIV %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    CD4 = median_iqr(CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL),
    VL_over_200 = paste0(
      sum(VL_over_200_flag, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(VL_over_200_flag, na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    Precon = paste0(
      sum(Precon_flag, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(Precon_flag, na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    Postcon = paste0(
      sum(!Precon_flag, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", 100 * mean(!Precon_flag, na.rm = TRUE)), "%)"
    ),
    weeks_on_ART = median_iqr(weeks_on_ART_precon),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_CD4 <- suppressWarnings(
  wilcox.test(CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL ~ Ethnicity, data = demographic.dataframe_HIV)$p.value
)
p_VL <- fisher.test(table(demographic.dataframe_HIV$VL_over_200_flag, demographic.dataframe_HIV$Ethnicity))$p.value
p_Precon <- fisher.test(table(demographic.dataframe_HIV$Precon_flag, demographic.dataframe_HIV$Ethnicity))$p.value
p_Postcon <- fisher.test(table(!demographic.dataframe_HIV$Precon_flag, demographic.dataframe_HIV$Ethnicity))$p.value

baseline_long <- baseline_stats %>%
  mutate(across(-Ethnicity, as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Ethnicity, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = case_when(
      Variable == "CD4" ~ p_CD4,
      Variable == "VL_over_200" ~ p_VL,
      Variable == "Precon" ~ p_Precon,
      Variable == "Postcon" ~ p_Postcon,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_ 
    )
  )

baseline_wide <- baseline_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Ethnicity, values_from = Value) %>%
  relocate(p_value, .after = last_col())

summarise_ART_by_subgroup <- function(df, group_var) {
  
  df_summary <- df %>%
    group_by(Ethnicity, !!sym(group_var)) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Ethnicity) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = sprintf("%.2f", 100 * n / sum(n)),
      value = paste0(n, " (", pct, "%)")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  subgroups <- unique(df[[group_var]])
  
  results <- lapply(subgroups, function(sub) {
    df$sub_flag <- df[[group_var]] == sub
    tbl <- table(df$sub_flag, df$Ethnicity)
    p_val <- if(sum(apply(tbl, 1, min) >= 2) >= 2) fisher.test(tbl)$p.value else NA_real_
    
    values <- df_summary %>%
      filter(!!sym(group_var) == sub) %>%
      select(Ethnicity, value) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Ethnicity, values_from = value)
    
    values %>%
      mutate(Variable = sub,
             p_value = p_val) %>%
      select(Variable, everything())
  })
  
  bind_rows(results)
}

ART_summary <- summarise_ART_by_subgroup(demographic.dataframe_HIV, "ART.Group")
ART_backbone_summary <- summarise_ART_by_subgroup(demographic.dataframe_HIV, "ARV.backbone")

final_summary <- bind_rows(
  baseline_wide,
  tibble(Variable = "ART Class", p_value = NA),
  ART_summary,
  tibble(Variable = "ART Backbone", p_value = NA),
  ART_backbone_summary
)

# Alpha diversity compared between subgroups 

library(FSA)

# adiv via chao 

adiv <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(ps.filtered, measures = c("Chao1")) %>%
  cbind(sample_data(ps.filtered)[, c("Ethnicity_HIV", "PID")]) %>%
  as.data.frame()

adiv <- adiv %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

sample_counts <- adiv %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Ethnicity_HIV, "\n(n=", n, ")"))

adiv_labeled <- adiv %>%
  left_join(sample_counts, by = "Ethnicity_HIV")

group_levels <- unique(adiv_labeled$label)
comparisons <- combn(group_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)


# global KW of AD 

kw <- kruskal.test(Chao1 ~ label, data = adiv_labeled)
print(kw$p.value)
## [1] 0.001017565
# Global KW was significant - follow up with Dunn's to assess pairwise comparisons 

dunn <- dunnTest(Chao1 ~ label, data = adiv_labeled, method = "bh")
## Warning: label was coerced to a factor.
pval_table <- dunn$res %>%
  select(group1 = Comparison, p.adj = P.adj) %>%
  separate(group1, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " - ")

pval_table <- pval_table %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3))
## Warning: There was 1 warning in `mutate()`.
## ℹ In argument: `across(where(is.numeric), round, 3)`.
## Caused by warning:
## ! The `...` argument of `across()` is deprecated as of dplyr 1.1.0.
## Supply arguments directly to `.fns` through an anonymous function instead.
## 
##   # Previously
##   across(a:b, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
## 
##   # Now
##   across(a:b, \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
# p value formatting 

pval_table <- pval_table %>%
  mutate(
    p.formatted = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.adj),
      TRUE          ~ sprintf("%.2f", p.adj)
    ),
    p.signif = case_when(
      p.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

max_val <- max(adiv_labeled$Chao1, na.rm = TRUE)
range_val <- diff(range(adiv_labeled$Chao1, na.rm = TRUE))

step <- range_val * 0.05

pval_table <- pval_table %>%
  arrange(group1, group2) %>%
  mutate(y.position = max_val + seq_len(n()) * step)


adiv_labeled$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(adiv_labeled$Ethnicity_HIV,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)

# Saving final figure with no titles and pdf 

adiv_plot1 <- ggplot(adiv_labeled, aes(x = label, y = Chao1)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Ethnicity_HIV), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Ethnicity and HIV Status",
    y = "Chao1 Diversity Index"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Ethnicity and HIV Status", values = c(
  "Black PWLWH" = "#4C78A8", 
  "White PWLWH" = "#F58518", 
  "Black PWWH"  = "#72B7B2",  
  "White PWWH"  = "#B279A2"  
  ))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(

      fill = NA,        
      linewidth = 0.25), 
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
) +
stat_pvalue_manual(
  pval_table,
  label = "p.formatted",
  tip.length = 0.02,
  hide.ns = TRUE,
  inherit.aes = FALSE
)

) %>%
  cbind(sample_data(ps.filtered)[, c("Ethnicity_HIV", "PID")]) %>%
  as.data.frame()

  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Chao1, Shannon, Simpson),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"

  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,

      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",

)

# y positions in each panel

  mutate(y.max = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%

  group_by(Metric) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = y.max + (row_number() * 0.05 * y.max)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Fisher's tests between subgroups to identify individual CSTs (not groupings) that are significantly different between subgroups

# All were NS but kept here for reference 

library(tibble)

cst_long <- cst_proportion %>%
  uncount(Count)

cst_summary <- cst_proportion %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Count),
    Proportion = round(100 * Count / Total, 1),
    Label = paste0(Count, " (", Proportion, "%)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cst_wide <- cst_summary %>%
  select(CST, Ethnicity_HIV, Label) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Ethnicity_HIV,
    values_from = Label,
    values_fill = "0 (0%)"
  )

cst_overall <- cst_proportion %>%
  group_by(CST) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(Count),
    Proportion = round(100 * sum(Count) / sum(cst_proportion$Count), 1),
    Label = paste0(Total, " (", Proportion, "%)")
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(cst_overall %>% select(CST, Overall = Label), by = "CST")

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  arrange(factor(CST, levels = c("I","II","III","IV-A","IV-B","IV-C","V")))

groups <- unique(cst_long$Ethnicity_HIV)
pairwise_groups <- combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Fisher's tests to examine CST prevalence between all subgroups 

pairwise_results <- map_df(unique(cst_long$CST), function(cst_type) {
  map_df(pairwise_groups, function(gpair) {
    table_2x2 <- cst_long %>%
      filter(Ethnicity_HIV %in% gpair) %>%
      mutate(CST_binary = if_else(CST == cst_type, cst_type, "Other")) %>%
      count(CST_binary, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Ethnicity_HIV, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
      column_to_rownames("CST_binary") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    if (nrow(table_2x2) < 2 || ncol(table_2x2) < 2 ||
        any(rowSums(table_2x2) == 0) || any(colSums(table_2x2) == 0)) {
      return(tibble(CST = cst_type, Group1 = gpair[1], Group2 = gpair[2], p_value = NA_real_))
    }
    
    fisher_res <- fisher.test(table_2x2, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
    
    tibble(
      CST = cst_type,
      Group1 = gpair[1],
      Group2 = gpair[2],
      p_value = fisher_res$p.value
    )
  })
})

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr") 
  )

print(pairwise_results)

# CST regression models - assignment to CST IV or CSTs I+II+V 

CSTModel <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  GAAge = metadata.filtered$Gestational.age1.wks,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV_Status,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  Gravidity = metadata.filtered$Gravida.number,
  Term = metadata.filtered$Term.birth,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  Complication = metadata.filtered$Complication,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother
)

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(Term = ifelse(Term == "y", "Y", Term))

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(CSTIV = CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"))

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(CSTIIIV = CST %in% c("I", "II", "V"))

CSTModel$CSTIV <- factor(CSTModel$CSTIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # testing if assigned to CST IV 
CSTModel$CSTIIIV <- factor(CSTModel$CSTIIIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # testing if assigned to CST I+II+V
CSTModel$HIV <- factor(CSTModel$HIV, levels = c("HIV+", "HIV-"))
CSTModel$Ethnicity <- factor(CSTModel$Ethnicity, levels = c("Black", "White"))
CSTModel$GAAge <- as.numeric(CSTModel$GAAge)
CSTModel$Age <- as.numeric(CSTModel$Age)
CSTModel$Gravidity <- as.numeric(CSTModel$Gravidity)
CSTModel$Term <- factor(CSTModel$Term, levels = c("Y", "N"))
CSTModel$Complication <- factor(CSTModel$Complication, levels = c("N", "Y")) # odds of complication (complication = Y)
CSTModel$BMI <- as.numeric(CSTModel$BMI)

# Odds of assignment to CST IV 

model <- glm(CSTIV ~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = CSTModel)

summary(model)

# Significant model - examine pairwise comparisons using emmeans 

library(emmeans)
## Warning: package 'emmeans' was built under R version 4.5.2
## Welcome to emmeans.
## Caution: You lose important information if you filter this package's results.
## See '? untidy'
em_model <- emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Ethnicity_HIV, type = "response", infer = c(TRUE, TRUE) )

contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(em_model$contrasts)

sig <- contrasts_df %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.10) %>%
  mutate(
    aOR = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / odds.ratio, odds.ratio),
    LCL = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / asymp.UCL, asymp.LCL),
    UCL = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL),
    report = paste0(
      "P: ", round(p.value, 2),
      ", aOR: ", round(aOR, 2),
      ", 95% CI: ", round(LCL, 2),
      "–", round(UCL, 2)
    )
  )

sig %>% select(contrast, report)

# HIV only models for CST assignment 

CSTModelHIV <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  GAAge = metadata.filtered$Gestational.age1.wks,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV_Status,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  Gravidity = metadata.filtered$Gravida.number,
  Term = metadata.filtered$Term.birth,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  Complication = metadata.filtered$Complication,
  VisitDate = metadata.filtered$Visit.Date,
  DateART = metadata.filtered$Date.ART.commenced, 
  CD4 = metadata.filtered$CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL,
  HIVVL = metadata.filtered$ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical, 
  ARTBackbone = metadata.filtered$ARV.backbone,
  ARTGroup = metadata.filtered$ART.Group,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother
)

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>% filter (HIV == "HIV+")

CSTModelHIV$HIVVL <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$HIVVL)
## Warning: NAs introduced by coercion
CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>%
  mutate(DetectableHIV = HIVVL > 50) # detectable HIV - greater than 50 copies at visit 

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>%
  mutate(CSTIV = CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"))

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>%
  mutate(CSTIIIV = CST %in% c("I", "II", "V"))

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>% mutate (PreconYN = DateART == "precon") # started ART preconception 


CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>%
  mutate(DateART = gsub(" ", "", DateART)) # date of ART initiation (if during pregnancy)

CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>%
  mutate(PreconYN = ifelse(DateART == "precon", TRUE, FALSE))


CSTModelHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>% mutate(Term = ifelse(Term == "y", "Y", Term))

CSTModelHIV$CSTIV <- factor(CSTModelHIV$CSTIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # testing assignment to CST IV
CSTModelHIV$CSTIIIV <- factor(CSTModelHIV$CSTIIIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # testing assignment to CST I+II+V 
CSTModelHIV$Ethnicity <- factor(CSTModelHIV$Ethnicity, levels = c("Black", "White"))
CSTModelHIV$GAAge <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$GAAge)
CSTModelHIV$Age <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$Age)
CSTModelHIV$Gravidity <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$Gravidity)
CSTModelHIV$Term <- factor(CSTModelHIV$Term, levels = c("Y", "N"))
CSTModelHIV$Complication <- factor(CSTModelHIV$Complication, levels = c("Y", "N")) # odds of complication 
CSTModelHIV$DetectableHIV <- factor(CSTModelHIV$DetectableHIV, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
CSTModelHIV$CD4 <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$CD4)
CSTModelHIV$PreconYN <- factor(CSTModelHIV$PreconYN, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
CSTModelHIV$BMI <- as.numeric(CSTModelHIV$BMI)

# Within HIV+ individuals, does detectable HIV level (>50 VL or not) impact the odds of assignment to CST I, II, or V? 

model <- glm(CSTIIIV ~ DetectableHIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = CSTModelHIV)

summary(model)

# prediction plot for above model 

new_data <- data.frame(
  CD4_100 = seq(min(CSTModelHIV$CD4_100, na.rm = TRUE),
                max(CSTModelHIV$CD4_100, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = 100),
  HIVVL = mean(CSTModelHIV$HIVVL, na.rm = TRUE),
  Age   = mean(CSTModelHIV$Age, na.rm = TRUE),
  BMI   = mean(CSTModelHIV$BMI, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Predict probabilities
new_data$pred <- predict(model, newdata = new_data, type = "response")


ggplot(new_data, aes(x = CD4_100, y = pred)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "CD4 count (per 100 cells/µL)",
       y = "Predicted Probability of CST I/II/V",
       title = "Predicted Probability of CSTIIIV") +
  theme_minimal()

preds <- predict(model, newdata = new_data, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)

new_data$fit <- preds$fit
new_data$se  <- preds$se.fit

# Convert from log-odds to probability
new_data$prob <- plogis(new_data$fit)
new_data$lower <- plogis(new_data$fit - 1.96 * new_data$se)
new_data$upper <- plogis(new_data$fit + 1.96 * new_data$se)

HIVPP <- ggplot(new_data, aes(x = CD4_100, y = prob)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "CD4 count (per 100 cells/µL)",
       y = "Predicted Probability of CST I, II, or V",
       title = "Predicted Probability of Optimal CSTs in PWLWH by CD4 Count",

# Relative abundance between subgroups of species with greater than 5% abundance in any sample 

# make counts out of 100 and melt to species level with name presented as genus species 

ps_rel_abund = transform_sample_counts(ps.filtered, function(x) x/sum(x)*100)
glom <- tax_glom(ps_rel_abund, taxrank = 'Species', NArm = FALSE)
ps.melt <- psmelt(glom)

# Select any species with greater than 5% abundance in any sample

ps.melt$Genus <- as.character(ps.melt$Genus)
ps.melt$Species <- as.character(ps.melt$Species)

ps.melt$GenusSpecies <- ifelse(
  is.na(ps.melt$Species) | ps.melt$Species == "" | ps.melt$Species == "unclassified",
  ps.melt$Genus,
  paste(ps.melt$Genus, ps.melt$Species, sep = " ")
)

top_taxa <- ps.melt %>%
  group_by(GenusSpecies, Sample) %>%           
  summarise(sample_abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(sample_abundance > 5) %>%             
  distinct(GenusSpecies) %>%                   
  pull(GenusSpecies)

ps.melt$GenusSpecies <- ifelse(ps.melt$GenusSpecies %in% top_taxa, 
                               ps.melt$GenusSpecies, 
                               "Other")

# Combine into a single 24-color palette
colors_24 <- c(palette1, palette2, palette3)


colors_24 <- c("#1B9E77", "#B2DF8A" ,"#984EA3", "#A6CEE3", "#FF7F00", "lightgoldenrod1", "#A65628", "#F781BF", "darkred" ,"#D95F02" ,"#7570B3" ,"#E7298A"  ,"#66C2A5" ,"#E6AB02", "indianred", "steelblue" ,"#A6761D" ,"lightgray" , "#E41A1C", "darkslateblue", "#FB9A99","#DECBE4" ,"darkgray","#FDDAEC")


ps.melt <- ps.melt %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )


ps.ethnicity_sum <- ps.melt %>%
  group_by(Sample, GenusSpecies,Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

total_abundance_per_sample <- ps.ethnicity_sum %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

ps.ethnicity_rel <- ps.ethnicity_sum %>%
  left_join(total_abundance_per_sample, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / TotalAbundance)

ps.ethnicity_label <- ps.ethnicity_rel %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, GenusSpecies) %>%
  summarise(TotalRelAbundance = sum(RelAbundance), .groups = "drop")

sample_counts <- ps.ethnicity_rel %>%
  distinct(Sample, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Ethnicity_HIV, "\n(n=", n, ")"))

ps.ethnicity_label <- ps.ethnicity_label %>%
  left_join(sample_counts, by = c("Ethnicity_HIV"))

ps.ethnicity_label <- ps.ethnicity_label %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  mutate(NormRelAbundance = TotalRelAbundance / sum(TotalRelAbundance)) %>%
  ungroup()

ps.ethnicity_label$label <- factor(ps.ethnicity_label$label, levels = unique(ps.ethnicity_label$label))

)

# Table with organised comparisons 

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

tidy_df <- results_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -taxon,
    names_to = "metric_comparison",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = sub("^(.*?)_.*$", "\\1", metric_comparison),
    comparison = sub("^[^_]+_(.*)$", "\\1", metric_comparison),
    comparison = gsub("_", " vs ", comparison)
  ) %>%
  select(taxon, comparison, metric, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value)
 
# filter to include all results with unadjusted p < 0.05 - included unadjusted results due to small numbers and many comparisons 

tidy_df_filtered <- filter(tidy_df, p < 0.05)

print(tidy_df_filtered)

# Lollipop plot with pairwise group comparisons 

tidy_res <- results_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -taxon,              
    names_to = "stat_comparison",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  separate(stat_comparison, into = c("stat", "comparison"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stat,
    values_from = value
  )

sig_res <- tidy_res %>% 
  filter(!is.na(p) & p < 0.05)

sig_res <- sig_res %>%
  separate(comparison, into = c("Group1", "Group2"), sep = "_", extra = "merge")

sig_res <- sig_res %>%
  mutate(
    Group1 = recode(
      Group1,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )


sig_res <- sig_res %>%
  mutate(
    Group2 = recode(
      Group2,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

# Lollipop plot

# Saved PDF version - displays significant (unadjusted p < 0.05) comparisons between subgroups

  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = lfc, y = taxon, yend = taxon)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Log2 Fold Change", 
    y = "Species",
    color = "Ethnicity and HIV Status",
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(

)

my_comparisons <- list(

  c("White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)

  mutate(Cytokine_plot = Cytokine %>%
           str_replace_all("TNF_a", "TNF-α") %>%

           str_replace_all("IFN_g", "IFN-γ"))

df_long_log <- df_long_log %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",

      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",

    )
  )

  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(Concentration)), .groups = "drop") %>%

# Wilcoxon comparisons between groups

  )

  mutate(
    ymin = min(df_long_log$Concentration_log[df_long_log$Cytokine_plot == first(Cytokine_plot)], na.rm = TRUE),
    maxy = max(df_long_log$Concentration_log[df_long_log$Cytokine_plot == first(Cytokine_plot)], na.rm = TRUE),
    yrange = maxy - ymin,

    step = 0.10 * yrange,
    base = maxy - 0.05 * yrange,

    y.position = base + step * (row_number() - 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

pval_table <- pairwise_wilcox %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    p.formatted = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.adj),
      TRUE          ~ sprintf("%.2f", p.adj)
    )
  )

  mutate(

    base = maxy - 0.05 * yrange,

    y.position = base + step * (row_number() - 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

    )
  )

# Cytokines emmeans (adjusted for age and BMI) and table with pairwise results 

library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

CSTModel <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  GAAge = metadata.filtered$Gestational.age1.wks,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV_Status,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother,
  Gravidity = metadata.filtered$Gravida.number,
  Term = metadata.filtered$Term.birth,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  Complication = metadata.filtered$Complication,
  IFN_g = metadata.filtered$IFN_g,
  IL_10 = metadata.filtered$IL_10,
  IL_12p70 = metadata.filtered$IL_12p70,
  IL_13 = metadata.filtered$IL_13,
  IL_1b = metadata.filtered$IL_1b,
  IL_2 = metadata.filtered$IL_2,
  IL_4 = metadata.filtered$IL_4,
  IL_6 = metadata.filtered$IL_6,
  IL_8 = metadata.filtered$IL_8,
  TNF_a = metadata.filtered$TNF_a
)

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(Term = ifelse(Term == "y", "Y", Term))

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(CSTIV = CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"))

CSTModel <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(CSTIIIV = CST %in% c("I", "II", "V"))

CSTModel$CSTIV <- factor(CSTModel$CSTIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # second level is what is being tested 
CSTModel$CSTIIIV <- factor(CSTModel$CSTIIIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
CSTModel$HIV <- factor(CSTModel$HIV, levels = c("HIV+", "HIV-"))
CSTModel$Ethnicity <- factor(CSTModel$Ethnicity, levels = c("Black", "White"))
CSTModel$GAAge <- as.numeric(CSTModel$GAAge)
CSTModel$Age <- as.numeric(CSTModel$Age)
CSTModel$Gravidity <- as.numeric(CSTModel$Gravidity)
CSTModel$Term <- factor(CSTModel$Term, levels = c("Y", "N")) # testing odds of preterm birth 
CSTModel$Complication <- factor(CSTModel$Complication, levels = c("Y", "N")) # odds of complication 
CSTModel$BMI <- as.numeric(CSTModel$BMI)

# cytokine columns 
cytokines <- c("IFN_g","IL_10","IL_12p70","IL_13","IL_1b","IL_2","IL_4","IL_6","IL_8","TNF_a")

# log x+1 transform cytokines in new dataset generated for model 

CSTModel[cytokines] <- lapply(CSTModel[cytokines], function(x) log10(x+1))

# Remove samples without cytokine data 

CSTModel_clean <- CSTModel %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cytokines), ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.x), NA, .x)))

# Create function for emmeans across all cytokines and store the results 

get_emm_all_pairs <- function(cyto, data) {

  m_adj <- lm(as.formula(paste(cyto, "~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI")), data = data)
  
  emm <- emmeans(m_adj, ~ Ethnicity_HIV)
  
  df_emm <- as.data.frame(emm) %>%
    mutate(Cytokine = cyto)
  
  pw <- pairs(emm)  #
  pw_df <- summary(pw) %>%
    select(contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value) %>%
    mutate(Cytokine = cyto)
  
  pw_df <- pw_df %>%
    separate(contrast, into = c("Group1", "Group2"), sep = " - ")
  
  pw_df <- pw_df %>%
    mutate(
      p.value.global = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
      Significant = ifelse(p.value.global < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
    )
  
  pw_df <- pw_df %>%
    mutate(
      Group1 = gsub("[()]", "", Group1),
      Group2 = gsub("[()]", "", Group2),
      comparison = paste(Group1, "vs", Group2)
    )
  
  list(emmeans = df_emm, pairwise = pw_df)
}

results <- map(cytokines, ~ get_emm_all_pairs(.x, CSTModel_clean))

emm_all <- map_df(results, "emmeans")
pairwise_all <- map_df(results, "pairwise")

# Only significant comparisons
sig_pairs <- pairwise_all %>%
  filter(Significant == "Yes") %>%
  select(Cytokine, Group1, Group2, comparison, estimate, SE, t.ratio, p.value.global, df)

sig_pairs_table <- data.frame(
Cytokine = sig_pairs$Cytokine, 
Comparison = sig_pairs$comparison,
Estimate = sig_pairs$estimate,
SE = sig_pairs$SE,
P_adjusted = sig_pairs$p.value.global,
df = sig_pairs$df
)

  select(PID, Ethnicity_HIV, CST, IFN_g, IL_10, IL_12p70, IL_13, IL_1b, IL_2, IL_4, IL_6, IL_8, TNF_a)

cytokine_pca <- cytokine_pca %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cytokines), ~log10(.x + 1))) %>% # transform
  mutate(across(all_of(cytokines), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) # scale prior to PCA 

cytokine_pca_clean <- cytokine_pca %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(cytokines), is.na)) # samples without cytokine data

scores_df <- cbind(scores_df, cytokine_pca_clean) # final dataset with PCAs linked back to PID/CST/Ethnicity+HIV

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(CSTFull = ifelse(CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"), "IV", CST))

# cytokine PCA between groups faceted by CST 

# Recreate previous dataframe as needed for analysis 

scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(pca_res))

scores_df <- cbind(scores_df, cytokine_pca_clean) # final dataset with PCAs linked back to PID/CST/Ethnicity+HIV

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(CSTFull = ifelse(CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"), "IV", CST))

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(CSTGroups = ifelse(CSTFull %in% c("I", "II", "V"), "I+II+V", CSTFull)) 

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

# Keep unadjusted p < 0.05 as some groups are very small 

library(rstatix)
pairwise_results <- scores_df %>%
  group_by(CSTGroups) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    PC1 ~ Ethnicity_HIV,
    p.adjust.method = "fdr"
  ) %>%
  filter(p < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(CSTGroups) %>%
  mutate(
    maxy = max(scores_df$PC1[scores_df$CSTGroups == first(CSTGroups)], na.rm = TRUE),
    y.position = maxy + 0.25 * row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    p_combined = sprintf(
        "%s (%s)",
        case_when(
       p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        p < 0.01  ~ sprintf("%.3f", p),
        TRUE      ~ sprintf("%.2f", p)
      ),
    case_when(
    p.adj < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    p.adj < 0.01  ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.adj),
    TRUE          ~ sprintf("%.2f", p.adj)
  )))

counts_df <- scores_df %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, CSTGroups) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

scores_df$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(scores_df$Ethnicity_HIV,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)


counts_df <- counts_df %>%
  mutate(
    y_pos = case_when(
      CSTGroups == "I+II+V" ~ -5.5,
      CSTGroups == "III" ~ -5.6,
      CSTGroups == "IV" ~ -3.6
    )
  )

# manuscript figure with significant comparisons only 

CSTInflammation <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = PC1, fill = Ethnicity_HIV)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
 geom_label(
  data = counts_df,
  aes(x = Ethnicity_HIV, y = y_pos, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  fill = "white", color = "grey35", alpha = 0.1,
  label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"), hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 4
) +
  facet_wrap(~CSTGroups, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Ethnicity and HIV Status",
    y = "PC1 (Overall Inflammation)"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Ethnicity and HIV Status", values = c(
  "Black PWLWH" = "#4C78A8",
  "White PWLWH" = "#F58518",
  "Black PWWH"  = "#72B7B2",
  "White PWWH"  = "#B279A2"
  )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 0.8, vjust = 1, size = 12), 
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",   
      fill = NA,        
      linewidth = 0.25), 
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
)  +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    pairwise_results,
    label = "p_combined",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    tip.length = 0.01,
    size = 4
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.17))
)

# tables with cytokine comparisons by CST for supplementary 

# Of samples assigned to CST I+II+V, what cytokines are significantly different between groups? 

metadata.filtered <- metadata.filtered %>%
  mutate(
    CSTFull = ifelse(CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"), "IV", CST),
    CSTGroups = ifelse(CSTFull %in% c("I", "II", "V"), "I+II+V", CSTFull))

cytokines <- metadata.filtered %>% 
  select(PID, CSTGroups, Ethnicity_HIV, IFN_g, IL_10, IL_12p70, IL_13, IL_1b, IL_2, IL_4, IL_6, IL_8, TNF_a)

df_long <- cytokines %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(PID, Ethnicity_HIV, CSTGroups),   
    names_to = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  ) %>%
  filter(CSTGroups %in% c("I+II+V")) # EDIT THIS AS NEEDED 

# Table for CST I+II+V 

# Log-transform
df_long_log <- df_long %>%
  mutate(Concentration_log = log10(Concentration + 1),
  Cytokine_plot = Cytokine %>%
           str_replace_all("TNF_a", "TNF-α") %>%
           str_replace_all("IL_1b", "IL-1β") %>%
           str_replace_all("IFN_g", "IFN-γ"))

df_long_log <- df_long_log %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

df_counts <- df_long_log %>%
  group_by(Cytokine_plot, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(Concentration)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ypos = -0.25)

df_long_log$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(df_long_log$Ethnicity_HIV,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)

library(rstatix)
pairwise_wilcox <- df_long_log %>%
  group_by(Cytokine_plot) %>%
  wilcox_test(Concentration_log ~ Ethnicity_HIV, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(group1 = group1, group2 = group2)

pairwise_wilcox_wide <- pairwise_wilcox %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste(group1, "vs", group2)) %>%
  select(Cytokine_plot, comparison, p.adj) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison,
    values_from = p.adj
  )

pairwise_wilcox_wide <- pairwise_wilcox_wide %>%
  mutate(Cytokine_plot = gsub("_", "-", Cytokine_plot))

pairwise_wilcox_wide <- pairwise_wilcox_wide %>%
  mutate(across(-Cytokine_plot, ~ ifelse(
    !is.na(.),
    ifelse(. < 0.01, formatC(., format = "e", digits = 2), formatC(., format = "f", digits = 2)),
    NA
  )))

pairwise_wilcox_numeric <- pairwise_wilcox_wide %>%
  mutate(across(-Cytokine_plot, as.numeric))

library(gt)

gt_table <- pairwise_wilcox_wide %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Pairwise Comparisons of Cytokines by Ethnicity and HIV Status in CSTs I+II+V During Pregnancy",
    subtitle = "FDR-adjusted Wilcoxon P-values | Significant (p < 0.05) Results are in Bold"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(Cytokine_plot = "Cytokine") %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    heading.title.font.size = px(20),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(16)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything() 
  ) %>%
   cols_width(
    everything() ~ px(120)  
  )

for(col in names(pairwise_wilcox_numeric)[-1]) { 
  gt_table <- gt_table %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = col,
        rows = pairwise_wilcox_numeric[[col]] < 0.05
      )
    )
}

adiv <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(ps.filtered, measures = c("Chao1")) %>%
  cbind(sample_data(ps.filtered)[, c("Ethnicity_HIV", "PID")]) %>%
  as.data.frame()

scores_df.adiv <- adiv %>%
  left_join(scores_df, by = "PID")

scores_df.adiv <- scores_df.adiv %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV.x = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV.x,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

scores_df.adiv <- scores_df.adiv[!is.na(scores_df.adiv$CSTGroups), ]

cor_by_cst <- scores_df.adiv %>%
  group_by(CSTGroups) %>%
  summarize(
    rho = cor(Chao1, PC1, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(Chao1, PC1, method = "spearman")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
## Warning: There were 2 warnings in `summarize()`.
## The first warning was:
## ℹ In argument: `p = cor.test(Chao1, PC1, method = "spearman")$p.value`.
## ℹ In group 1: `CSTGroups = "I+II+V"`.
## Caused by warning in `cor.test.default()`:
## ! Cannot compute exact p-value with ties
## ℹ Run `dplyr::last_dplyr_warnings()` to see the 1 remaining warning.
cor_by_cst <- cor_by_cst %>%
  mutate(
    p.formatted = ifelse(
      p < 0.01,
      sprintf("%.2e", p),  
      sprintf("%.2f", p)   
    )) 

print(cor_by_cst)

## 3 IV        0.473 0.0238 0.02
scores_df.adiv <- scores_df.adiv %>%
  left_join(cor_by_cst, by = "CSTGroups")

scores_df.adiv$Ethnicity_HIV.x <- factor(scores_df.adiv$Ethnicity_HIV.x,

# Cytokine PCA compared between CSTs within subgroups 

scores_df <- scores_df %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

library(rstatix)
pairwise_results <- scores_df %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%                       
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    PC1 ~ CSTGroups,                          
    p.adjust.method = "fdr"                       
  ) %>%
    group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  mutate(y.position = max(scores_df$PC1[scores_df$Ethnicity_HIV == unique(Ethnicity_HIV)], na.rm = TRUE) + 1.75 * row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    p_combined = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", p, p.adj)
  )


counts_df <- scores_df %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, CSTGroups) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

library(dplyr)

counts_df <- counts_df %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV = recode(
      Ethnicity_HIV,
      "Black HIV+"  = "Black PWLWH",
      "White HIV+"  = "White PWLWH",
      "Black HIV-"  = "Black PWWH",
      "White HIV-"  = "White PWWH"
    )
  )

# Generating overall figure first

  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
 geom_label(
  data = counts_df,
  aes(x = CSTGroups, y = -6.5, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  fill = "white", color = "black", alpha = 0.8,
  label.size = 0.4, label.padding = unit(0.3, "lines")
) +
  facet_wrap(~Ethnicity_HIV) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "CST", values = c(
    "I+II+V" = "#006400",
    "III" = "#eb8a14",
    "IV" = "#8b0000"
  )) + 
  labs(
    x = "CST Group",
    y = "PC1 (Overall Inflammation)"
  )  +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(

      linewidth = 0.25),

axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
) +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(

    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,

mat

# Test for social deprivation comparison (discussion)

# 2019 indices - sourced from https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/english-indices-of-deprivation-2019 and mapped to clinic post code 

kruskal.test(SDI_2019 ~ Ethnicity_HIV, data = metadata.filtered)
## 
##  Kruskal-Wallis rank sum test
## 
## data:  SDI_2019 by Ethnicity_HIV
## Kruskal-Wallis chi-squared = 29.094, df = 3, p-value = 2.14e-06
dunn <- dunnTest(SDI_2019 ~ Ethnicity_HIV, data = metadata.filtered, method = "bh")
## Warning: Ethnicity_HIV was coerced to a factor.
format_pval <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p > 0.01,
         sprintf("%.2f", p),          
         formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))  
}

dunn$res$P.adj.formatted <- format_pval(dunn$res$P.adj)
dunn$res

# BLACK PWLWH PTB ANALYSIS - TRIMESTER 2 USING ABOVE DATASET (SAME ASV/METADATA)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# What is driving PTB in Black PWLWH?

CSTModelHIV <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  GAAge = metadata.filtered$Gestational.age1.wks,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV_Status,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  Gravidity = metadata.filtered$Gravida.number,
  Term = metadata.filtered$Term.birth,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  Complication = metadata.filtered$Complication,
  VisitDate = metadata.filtered$Visit.Date,
  DateART = metadata.filtered$Date.ART.commenced, 
  CD4 = metadata.filtered$CD4.count.at.screening.cells.mcL,
  HIVVL = metadata.filtered$ViralLoad_Screening_Numerical, 
  ARTBackbone = metadata.filtered$ARV.backbone,
  ARTGroup = metadata.filtered$ART.Group,
  GADelivery = metadata.filtered$GA.at.delivery.weeks,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother
)

CSTModel_BlackHIV <- CSTModelHIV %>% filter(Ethnicity_HIV == "Black HIV+") # Filter for Black PWLWH 

CSTModel_BlackHIV$HIVVL <- as.numeric(CSTModel_BlackHIV$HIVVL)
## Warning: NAs introduced by coercion
CSTModel_BlackHIV <- CSTModel_BlackHIV %>%
  mutate(DetectableHIV = HIVVL > 50)

CSTModel_BlackHIV <- CSTModel_BlackHIV %>%
  mutate(CSTIV = CST %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C"))

CSTModel_BlackHIV <- CSTModel_BlackHIV %>%
  mutate(CSTIIIV = CST %in% c("I", "II", "V"))

CSTModel_BlackHIV <- CSTModel_BlackHIV %>% mutate (PreconYN = DateART == "precon" )

CSTModel_BlackHIV <- CSTModel_BlackHIV %>%
  mutate(FirstPregnancy = Gravidity == 1)

CSTModel_BlackHIV <- CSTModel_BlackHIV %>%
  mutate(AMA = Age > 34) # advanced maternal age 

CSTModel_BlackHIV <- CSTModel_BlackHIV %>%
  mutate(DateART = gsub(" ", "", DateART))

CSTModel_BlackHIV <- CSTModel_BlackHIV %>%
  mutate(PreconYN = ifelse(DateART == "precon", TRUE, FALSE),
    Term = ifelse(Term == "y", "Y", Term),
    Overweight = BMI > 25)

CSTModel_BlackHIV$CSTIV <- factor(CSTModel_BlackHIV$CSTIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")) # second level is what is being tested 
CSTModel_BlackHIV$CSTIIIV <- factor(CSTModel_BlackHIV$CSTIIIV, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
CSTModel_BlackHIV$Ethnicity <- factor(CSTModel_BlackHIV$Ethnicity, levels = c("Black", "White"))
CSTModel_BlackHIV$GAAge <- as.numeric(CSTModel_BlackHIV$GAAge)
CSTModel_BlackHIV$Age <- as.numeric(CSTModel_BlackHIV$Age)
CSTModel_BlackHIV$Gravidity <- as.numeric(CSTModel_BlackHIV$Gravidity)
CSTModel_BlackHIV$Term <- factor(CSTModel_BlackHIV$Term, levels = c("Y", "N"))
CSTModel_BlackHIV$Complication <- factor(CSTModel_BlackHIV$Complication, levels = c("Y", "N")) # odds of complication 
CSTModel_BlackHIV$DetectableHIV <- factor(CSTModel_BlackHIV$DetectableHIV, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
CSTModel_BlackHIV$CD4 <- as.numeric(CSTModel_BlackHIV$CD4)
CSTModel_BlackHIV$PreconYN <- factor(CSTModel_BlackHIV$PreconYN, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
CSTModel_BlackHIV$GADelivery <- as.numeric(CSTModel_BlackHIV$GADelivery)
## Warning: NAs introduced by coercion
CSTModel_BlackHIV$FirstPregnancy <- factor(CSTModel_BlackHIV$FirstPregnancy, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
CSTModel_BlackHIV$AMA <- factor(CSTModel_BlackHIV$AMA, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
CSTModel_BlackHIV$Overweight <- factor(CSTModel_BlackHIV$Overweight, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
CSTModel_BlackHIV$BMI <- as.numeric(CSTModel_BlackHIV$BMI)

# Odds of PTB based on CST I+II+V assignment @ mid second trimester - complex (covariates) and simple model (both NS) 

model <- glm(Term ~ CSTIIIV + Age + Gravidity, family = binomial, data = CSTModel_BlackHIV)

summary(model)

# Differential abundance (ANCOM) of Black PWLWH who gave birth preterm vs at term 

ps.cleaned <- prune_samples(sample_names(ps.filtered)[sample_data(ps.filtered)$Term.birth %in% c("Y","N")], ps.filtered)
ps.filtered_BH <- subset_samples(ps.cleaned, Ethnicity_HIV == "Black HIV+")

otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps.filtered_BH))
tax_mat <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps.filtered_BH))

tax_mat$GenusSpecies <- ifelse(
  is.na(tax_mat$Species) | tax_mat$Species == "",
  tax_mat$Genus,
  paste(tax_mat$Genus, tax_mat$Species, sep = " ")
)

otu_agg <- aggregate(otu_mat, by = list(GenusSpecies = tax_mat$GenusSpecies), FUN = sum)
rownames(otu_agg) <- otu_agg$GenusSpecies
otu_agg$GenusSpecies <- NULL

tax_agg <- tax_mat[!duplicated(tax_mat$GenusSpecies), ]
rownames(tax_agg) <- tax_agg$GenusSpecies

tax_agg$GenusSpecies <- NULL

ps_genusspecies <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(as.matrix(otu_agg), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(as.matrix(tax_agg)),
  sample_data(ps.filtered_BH)
)

ps_genusspecies

)

# LONGITUDINAL ANALYSIS (NEW ASV/METADATA FILE)

# load data 

asv_raw <- read.csv("Trimester2CSTChange//Mergedfiles_EmilyEditFullASVs.csv", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

taxonomy_strings <- asv_raw[[1]]

asv_ids <- paste0("ASV", seq_len(nrow(asv_raw)))

rownames(asv_raw) <- asv_ids

count_data <- asv_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE]

count_data[] <- lapply(count_data, as.numeric)

otu_mat <- as.matrix(count_data)

tax_split <- strsplit(taxonomy_strings, ";")

tax_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tax_split, function(x) {
  length(x) <- 7
  return(x)
}))

colnames(tax_mat) <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
rownames(tax_mat) <- asv_ids

OTU <- otu_table(otu_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_mat))
ps <- phyloseq(OTU, TAX)
metadata <- read.csv("Trimester2CSTChange/FullHIVRaceUKMetadata_PairedSearch.csv")
setwd("../../../")
cst_data <- read.csv("CSTData.csv")
names(cst_data)[names(cst_data) == "NEWsampleID"] <- "Sample_ID"
names(metadata)[names(metadata) == "Barcode_Sample.Name"] <- "Sample_ID"
metadata <- merge(metadata, cst_data[, c("Sample_ID", "CST")], by = "Sample_ID", all.x = TRUE)

missingIDs <- metadata[is.na(metadata$CST), ]


rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Sample_ID
metadata <- metadata[, !names(metadata) %in% "Sample_ID"]
sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(metadata)

# Run this to make sure no samples are dropped 

otu_samples <- sample_names(ps)  
meta_samples <- sample_names(metadata)
  
intersect(otu_samples, meta_samples)        
## NULL
setdiff(otu_samples, meta_samples)

# filtering and data cleaning  

# remove singletons
ps.prune = prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps) > 1, ps)


# remove taxa that occur in less than 5% of samples 

ps.prune <- filter_taxa(ps.prune, function(x) sum(x > 0) > 0.05 * nsamples(ps), TRUE)

# Check read count
readcount_sr = data.table(as(sample_data(ps.prune), "data.frame"),
                 TotalReads = sample_sums(ps.prune), 
                 keep.rownames = TRUE)
setnames(readcount_sr, "rn", "SampleID")


# check read count and determine which PIDs to remove from the data set 

readcount <- (readcount_sr[order(readcount_sr$TotalReads), c("SampleID", "TotalReads", "PID")])

print(readcount)

# Creating overall CST change figure 

# overall CST change figure - not stratified by subgroups 

library(ggalluvial)

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint
)

CSTTransition$Timepoint <- factor(CSTTransition$Timepoint, 
                                              levels = c(1, 2), 
                                              labels = c("1", "2"))

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  filter(!is.na(CST))


stratum_props <- CSTTransition %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, CST) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label_single_line = paste0(
      CST, " - n=", n, " (", scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1), ")"
    )
  )

stratum_props

##    Timepoint CST       n   prop label_single_line

##  4 1         IV-A      8 0.0842 IV-A - n=8 (8%)  
##  5 1         IV-B     19 0.2    IV-B - n=19 (20%)

## 13 2         V        11 0.116  V - n=11 (12%)
# Join both prop and CST to CSTTransition
CSTTransition_labeled <- CSTTransition %>%
  left_join(
    stratum_props %>% select(Timepoint, CST, prop, label_single_line),
    by = c("Timepoint", "CST")
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = label_single_line)


# final pdf of cst change figure 

# make CST label without the percentages or n labels 

stratum_props <- CSTTransition %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, CST) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label_single_line = paste0(
      CST)
  )

CSTTransition_labeled <- CSTTransition %>%
  left_join(
    stratum_props %>% select(Timepoint, CST, prop, label_single_line),
    by = c("Timepoint", "CST")
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = label_single_line)

# suppress CST IV-C

CSTTransition_labeled$label <- ifelse(
  CSTTransition_labeled$CST == "IV-C",
  "",
  CSTTransition_labeled$label
)

# CST losses and gains by subgroup 

cst_wide <- CSTTransition %>%
  select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CST,
              names_prefix = "TP")

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    change_type = case_when(
      TP1 == TP2 ~ "Same CST",
      TRUE ~ "Different CST"
    )
  )

change_summary <- cst_wide %>%
  count(change_type) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

print(change_summary)

## 2 Same CST         59 0.621
transition_table <- cst_wide %>%
  count(TP1, TP2) %>%
  group_by(TP1) %>%
  mutate(row_prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

                                              labels = c("1", "2"))

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  filter(!is.na(CST))


stratum_props <- CSTTransition %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint, CST) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label_single_line = paste0(CST, " - ", scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1))
  )

# Join both prop and CST to CSTTransition
CSTTransition_labeled <- CSTTransition %>%
  left_join(
    stratum_props %>% select(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint, CST, prop, label_single_line),
    by = c("Ethnicity_HIV", "Timepoint", "CST")
  ) %>%
  # Now use the one-line label with dash
  mutate(label = label_single_line)

counts <- CSTTransition %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(SampleID))

facet_labels <- paste0(counts$Ethnicity_HIV, "\n", "n = ", counts$n)
names(facet_labels) <- counts$Ethnicity_HIV


CSTTransition_labeled$Ethnicity_HIV <- factor(
  CSTTransition_labeled$Ethnicity_HIV,
  levels = c("Black PWLWH", "Black PWWH", "White PWLWH", "White PWWH")
)

# change counts by subgroup  

cst_wide <- CSTTransition %>%
  select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CST,
              names_prefix = "TP")

change_summary <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    change_type = case_when(
      TP1 == TP2 ~ "Same CST",
      TRUE ~ "Different CST"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, change_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

print(change_summary)

      TRUE ~ CST
    )
  ) %>%
  select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST_collapsed) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CST_collapsed,
              names_prefix = "TP")

transitions_BW <- cst_wideBW %>%
  filter(!is.na(TP1), !is.na(TP2)) %>%
  filter(TP1 != TP2)

transition_counts_raw <- transitions_BW %>%
  count(TP1, TP2, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    transition = paste0(TP1, " → ", TP2)
  )

transition_counts_raw %>%
  filter(
    (TP1 == "III" & TP2 == "IV") |
    (TP1 == "IV" & TP2 == "III")
  ) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n))

summary_table <- tibble(
  III_IV_transitions = transition_counts_raw %>%
    filter((TP1 == "III" & TP2 == "IV") | (TP1 == "IV" & TP2 == "III")) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n)) %>% pull(n),

  into_III_IV = transition_counts_raw %>%
    filter(TP2 %in% c("III", "IV") & !(TP1 %in% c("III", "IV"))) %>%

# transitions between I+II+V or III+IV 

CSTTransition2 <- CSTTransition %>%
  mutate(
    CST_group = case_when(
      CST %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I+II+V",
      CST %in% c("III", "IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "III+IV",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cst_wide <- CSTTransition2 %>%
  select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint, CST_group) %>%

cst_transitions <- cst_wide %>%

      TP1 == "I+II+V" & TP2 == "III+IV" ~ "I+II+V → III+IV",

  ungroup() %>%
  select(Ethnicity_HIV, transition, `n (%)`)

# CST change regression models 

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  VisitDate = metadata.filtered$Visit.Date,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV
  )

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  mutate(CST = as.character(CST))

pid_info <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV, BMI, Age, Ethnicity, HIV) %>%
  distinct()

timepoint_CST <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST, VisitDate) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c(1,2))

cst_wide <- timepoint_CST %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = c(CST, VisitDate),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_prefix = "Timepoint_"
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(pid_info, by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, everything())

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>% filter(!is.na(Age) & !is.na(BMI))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(transitions_to_III_IV = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "v") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-B", "IV-A", "IV-C", "III"),
         transitions_to_I_II_V = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V"),
         stability = ifelse(CST_Timepoint_1 == CST_Timepoint_2, TRUE, FALSE))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_2, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    VisitDate_Timepoint_1 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_1, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    Days_between = as.numeric(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 - VisitDate_Timepoint_1), 
    Weeks_between = as.numeric(Days_between / 7))

cst_wide$stability <- factor(cst_wide$stability,
                             levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))

# Odds of CST stability by Ethnicity*HIV 

model <- glm(stability ~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = cst_wide)
summary(model)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = stability ~ Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, 
##     data = cst_wide)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                          Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)  
## (Intercept)              -0.42368    1.54802  -0.274   0.7843  
## Ethnicity_HIVBlack PWWH  -1.58896    0.83757  -1.897   0.0578 .
## Ethnicity_HIVWhite PWLWH -0.45064    0.64357  -0.700   0.4838  
## Ethnicity_HIVWhite PWWH  -0.95408    0.63697  -1.498   0.1342  
## Age                       0.03900    0.04291   0.909   0.3635  
## BMI                      -0.03528    0.03534  -0.998   0.3182  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 121.21  on 91  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 113.21  on 86  degrees of freedom
## AIC: 125.21
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 4
library(emmeans)

emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Ethnicity_HIV, type = "response")
## $emmeans
##  Ethnicity_HIV  prob     SE  df asymp.LCL asymp.UCL
##  Black PWLWH   0.474 0.0762 Inf    0.3312     0.621
##  Black PWWH    0.155 0.1010 Inf    0.0389     0.455
##  White PWLWH   0.365 0.1310 Inf    0.1591     0.636
##  White PWWH    0.258 0.1050 Inf    0.1061     0.504
## 
## Confidence level used: 0.95 
## Intervals are back-transformed from the logit scale 
## 
## $contrasts
##  contrast                  odds.ratio    SE  df null z.ratio p.value
##  Black PWLWH / Black PWWH        4.90 4.100 Inf    1   1.897  0.2292
##  Black PWLWH / White PWLWH       1.57 1.010 Inf    1   0.700  0.8970
##  Black PWLWH / White PWWH        2.60 1.650 Inf    1   1.498  0.4388
##  Black PWWH / White PWLWH        0.32 0.307 Inf    1  -1.189  0.6340
##  Black PWWH / White PWWH         0.53 0.501 Inf    1  -0.672  0.9077
##  White PWLWH / White PWWH        1.65 1.310 Inf    1   0.637  0.9200
## 
## P value adjustment: tukey method for comparing a family of 4 estimates 
## Tests are performed on the log odds ratio scale
# Odds of CST stability by Ethnicity+HIV 

cst_wide$HIV <- relevel(
  cst_wide$HIV,
  ref = "PWWH"
)

model <- glm(stability ~ Ethnicity + HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = cst_wide)
summary(model)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = stability ~ Ethnicity + HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, 
##     data = cst_wide)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)  
## (Intercept)    -1.62494    1.46436  -1.110   0.2671  
## EthnicityWhite -0.09286    0.51366  -0.181   0.8565  
## HIVPWLWH        1.05232    0.55035   1.912   0.0559 .
## Age             0.04499    0.04198   1.072   0.2838  
## BMI            -0.04005    0.03481  -1.150   0.2500  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 121.21  on 91  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 114.14  on 87  degrees of freedom
## AIC: 124.14
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 4
# OR for above model 

library(broom)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   # remove intercept
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "aOR ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

## 3 Age            aOR 1.05, 95% CI 0.96–1.14; p = 0.28 
## 4 BMI            aOR 0.96, 95% CI 0.89–1.03; p = 0.25
print(results)

library(emmeans)

em_model <- emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Ethnicity_HIV, type = "response", infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))

contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(em_model$contrasts)

sig <- contrasts_df %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.10) %>%
  mutate(
    aOR = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / odds.ratio, odds.ratio),
    LCL = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / asymp.UCL, asymp.LCL),
    UCL = ifelse(odds.ratio < 1, 1 / asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL),
    report = paste0(
      "p:", round(p.value, 2),
      "aOR: ", round(aOR, 2),
      ", 95% CI: ", round(LCL, 2),
      "–", round(UCL, 2)
    )
  )

# testing if weeks between is SD by Ethnicity_HIV groups  

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  VisitDate = metadata.filtered$Visit.Date,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV
  )

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  mutate(CST = as.character(CST))

pid_info <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV, BMI, Age, Ethnicity, HIV) %>%
  distinct()

timepoint_CST <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST, VisitDate) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c(1,2))

cst_wide <- timepoint_CST %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = c(CST, VisitDate),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_prefix = "Timepoint_"
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(pid_info, by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, everything())

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_2, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    VisitDate_Timepoint_1 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_1, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    Days_between = as.numeric(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 - VisitDate_Timepoint_1), 
    Weeks_between = as.numeric(Days_between / 7))


cst_wide$Ethnicity_HIV <- as.factor(cst_wide$Ethnicity_HIV)
cst_wide$Days_between <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Days_between)

kruskal.test(Days_between ~ Ethnicity_HIV, data = cst_wide)
## 
##  Kruskal-Wallis rank sum test
## 
## data:  Days_between by Ethnicity_HIV
## Kruskal-Wallis chi-squared = 4.5568, df = 3, p-value = 0.2073
avg_weeks <- mean(cst_wide$Weeks_between, na.rm = TRUE) # average weeks between two appointments 

print(avg_weeks)
## [1] 7.184962
cst_wide$BMI <- as.numeric(cst_wide$BMI)
cst_wide$Age <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Age)
cst_wide$Weeks_between <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Weeks_between)

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_HIV_Grouping = case_when(
      Ethnicity_HIV == "Black PWLWH" ~ "Black PWLWH",

# Odds of change/stability by subgroup within various CSTs 

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV,
  BMI = metadata.filtered$Body.Mass.Index.of.mother,
  Age = metadata.filtered$Age,
  VisitDate = metadata.filtered$Visit.Date,
  Ethnicity = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity,
  HIV = metadata.filtered$HIV
  )

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  mutate(CST = as.character(CST))

pid_info <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV, BMI, Age, Ethnicity, HIV) %>%
  distinct()

timepoint_CST <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST, VisitDate) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c(1,2))

cst_wide <- timepoint_CST %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = c(CST, VisitDate),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_prefix = "Timepoint_"
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(pid_info, by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, everything())

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>% filter(!is.na(Age) & !is.na(BMI))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(transitions_to_III_IV = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "v") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-B", "IV-A", "IV-C", "III"),
         transitions_to_I_II_V = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V"),
         stability = ifelse(CST_Timepoint_1 == CST_Timepoint_2, TRUE, FALSE))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_2, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    VisitDate_Timepoint_1 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_1, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    Days_between = as.numeric(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 - VisitDate_Timepoint_1), 
    Weeks_between = as.numeric(Days_between / 7))

cst_wide$stability<- factor(cst_wide$stability, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE")) # testing odds of change 
cst_wide$BMI <- as.numeric(cst_wide$BMI)
cst_wide$Age <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Age)
cst_wide$Weeks_between <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Weeks_between)

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
    mutate(
    CST_Group_T1 = case_when(
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I_II_V",
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "IV",
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("III") ~ "III",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Main model to explore the interaction between CST @ timepoint 1 and HIV_Ethnicity and their effect on stability (adjusted for BMI/age) - all ns  

model <- glm(stability ~ CST_Group_T1 * Ethnicity_HIV + Age + BMI, family = binomial, data = cst_wide)

summary(model)

# table with CST change data 

CSTTransition <- data.frame(
  SampleID = metadata.filtered$PID,
  CST = metadata.filtered$CST,
  Timepoint = metadata.filtered$My_timepoint,
  Ethnicity_HIV = metadata.filtered$Ethnicity_HIV
  )

CSTTransition <- CSTTransition %>%
  mutate(CST = as.character(CST))

pid_info <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Ethnicity_HIV) %>%
  distinct()

timepoint_CST <- CSTTransition %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c(1,2))

cst_wide <- timepoint_CST %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = c(CST),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_prefix = "Timepoint_"
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(pid_info, by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, everything())

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
    mutate(
    Timepoint_1 = case_when(
      Timepoint_1 %in% c("I") ~ "I",
      Timepoint_1 %in% c("II") ~ "II",
      Timepoint_1 %in% c("V") ~ "V",
      Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "IV",
      Timepoint_1 %in% c("III") ~ "III",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
    mutate(
    Timepoint_2 = case_when(
      Timepoint_2 %in% c("I") ~ "I",
      Timepoint_2 %in% c("II") ~ "II",
      Timepoint_2 %in% c("V") ~ "V",
      Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C") ~ "IV",
      Timepoint_2 %in% c("III") ~ "III",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(Stability = ifelse(Timepoint_1 == Timepoint_2, TRUE, FALSE))

# calculate stability at each timepoint

summary <- cst_wide %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint_1, Stability) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint_1) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(count, " (", round(100 * count / sum(count), 2), "%)")) %>%
  select(Ethnicity_HIV, Timepoint_1, Stability, label) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Stability, values_from = label, values_fill = "0 (0%)") %>%
  rename(`Stable CST` = `TRUE`, `CST Change` = `FALSE`) %>%
  ungroup()


library(gt)

summary_gt <- summary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Stable CST`, `CST Change`), names_to = "Stability_type", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(col_name = paste0(Timepoint_1, "_", Stability_type)) %>%
  select(Ethnicity_HIV, col_name, Value) %>%
 pivot_wider(names_from = col_name,
              values_from = Value,
              values_fill = list(Value = "0 (0%)"))

gt_table <- gt(summary_gt, rowname_col = "Ethnicity_HIV")

csts <- unique(summary$Timepoint_1)
for(cst in csts){
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", cst, "_"), names(summary_gt), value = TRUE)
  gt_table <- gt_table %>%
    tab_spanner(label = cst, columns = cols) %>%
    cols_label(
  !!paste0(cst, "_Stable CST") := "Stable",
  !!paste0(cst, "_CST Change") := "Changed"
)
}

  dplyr::select(SampleID, Timepoint, CST, VisitDate) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c(1,2))

cst_wide <- timepoint_CST %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = c(CST, VisitDate),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_prefix = "Timepoint_"
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  left_join(pid_info, by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, everything())


cst_wide <- cst_wide %>% filter(!is.na(Age) & !is.na(BMI))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(transitions_to_III_IV = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "v") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-B", "IV-A", "IV-C", "III"),
         transitions_to_I_II_V = CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") &
                             CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V"),
         stability = ifelse(CST_Timepoint_1 == CST_Timepoint_2, TRUE, FALSE))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_2, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    VisitDate_Timepoint_1 = as.Date(VisitDate_Timepoint_1, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    Days_between = as.numeric(VisitDate_Timepoint_2 - VisitDate_Timepoint_1), 
    Weeks_between = as.numeric(Days_between / 7))

cst_wide$stability<- factor(cst_wide$stability, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE")) # testing odds of change 
cst_wide$BMI <- as.numeric(cst_wide$BMI)
cst_wide$Age <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Age)
cst_wide$Weeks_between <- as.numeric(cst_wide$Weeks_between)


cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Had_CST_I_II_V = if_else(
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "V") | CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V"),
      TRUE,   
      FALSE   
    )
  )

cst_wide$Had_CST_I_II_V = factor(cst_wide$Had_CST_I_II_V, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
    mutate(
    CST_Group_T1 = case_when(
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I_II_V",
      CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") ~ "IV_subtypes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cst_wide <- cst_wide %>%
  mutate(
    CST_Group_T2 = case_when(
      CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("I", "II", "V") ~ "I_II_V",
      CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "III") ~ "IV_subtypes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# PTB models 

cst_wide_filtered <- cst_wide %>% filter(Ethnicity_HIV == "Black PWLWH")

cst_wide_filtered$Term <- factor(cst_wide_filtered$Term, levels = c("Y", "N"))

# Transition data

cst_wide_filtered1 <- cst_wide_filtered %>%
  filter(Term == "N") %>%
  mutate(
    Transition = paste0(CST_Timepoint_1, " -> ", CST_Timepoint_2)
  )

cst_wide_filterted_transitions <- cst_wide_filtered1 %>%
  select(Transition)

print(cst_wide_filterted_transitions)

# CST stability on odds of PTB 

model <- glm(Term ~ stability, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_filtered)
summary(model)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = Term ~ stability, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_filtered)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)   
## (Intercept)     -1.9459     0.6172  -3.153  0.00162 **
## stabilityFALSE   1.2528     0.7715   1.624  0.10442   
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 47.674  on 44  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 44.819  on 43  degrees of freedom
##   (1 observation deleted due to missingness)
## AIC: 48.819
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 4
library(broom)

results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   
  mutate(
    report = paste0(
      "aOR ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", 95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2),
      "–", round(conf.high, 2),
      "; p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

results %>% select(term, report)

##   <chr>          <chr>

# Transition between III/IV vs not (True/False if it was experienced)

cst_wide_filtered <- cst_wide_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    # Collapse CST IV subtypes into "IV", everything else stays as is
    CST_TP1_group = if_else(CST_Timepoint_1 == "III", "III",
                             if_else(CST_Timepoint_1 %in% c("IV-A","IV-B","IV-C"), "IV",
                                     "Other")),
    CST_TP2_group = if_else(CST_Timepoint_2 == "III", "III",
                             if_else(CST_Timepoint_2 %in% c("IV-A","IV-B","IV-C"), "IV",
                                     "Other")),
    
    # TRUE if III ↔ IV transition, FALSE otherwise
    CST_III_IV_Transition_Any = if_else(
      (CST_TP1_group == "III" & CST_TP2_group == "IV") |
      (CST_TP1_group == "IV"  & CST_TP2_group == "III"),
      TRUE,
      FALSE
    )
  )

model <- glm(Term ~ CST_III_IV_Transition_Any, family = binomial, data = cst_wide_filtered)
summary(model)
